Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.propertygenerator

Class OlgaEnvelopeInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.propertygenerator.OlgaEnvelopeInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
final class OlgaEnvelopeInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Phase-envelope extents of the water-free feed, used for the table header and for envelope grid refinement.

Water dominates the envelope of a wet feed (its dew line reaches far above the hydrocarbon cricondentherm), so the critical point and the refinement window are taken from a water-free copy. The table header keywords CRITICALPRESSURE and CRITICALTEMPERATURE are therefore those of the water-free feed. Water is removed when it is the last component and otherwise reduced to a trace; the full feed is used if the water-free envelope fails.
